title: Natural integral dual-formula comparison with transported trace normalization
statement: Fix a finite-field datum $D$, a prime $\ell$ different from its characteristic, and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber, def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $X,Y$ be separated finite-type schemes over $D.k$, let $f:X\to Y$ be a separated finite-type morphism over $D.k$, and let $c$ be a compactification of $f$. Supply coherent integral dualizing data $w_X,w_Y$ [def-sf-coherent-integral-dualizing-datum] and proofs that the ordinary internal-Hom duals into their dualizing objects preserve the integral constructible categories. Let $a_X,a_Z,a_Y$ be representative-normalized ordinary tensor presentations on $X,c.Z,Y$ [def-sf-integral-hom-reduction-models], and supply the signed symmetry $s_X$ of $a_X$ [def-sf-integral-verdier-models]. Suppose a functor $G:D^b_c(Y,\mathcal O_E)\to D^b_c(X,\mathcal O_E)$ is equipped with an adjunction $Rf_{!,c}\dashv G$ for the prescribed integral compact support. Then there is a natural isomorphism $e:G\cong D_X f^* D_Y$, using the prescribed completed pullback [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom] and the supplied preservation proofs to restrict the two duals. Transport the given adjunction along $e$. At every integral object $M$, its identity formula component satisfies FormulaNormalized for the supplied $a_X,a_Z,a_Y,s_X$ [lem-coef-dual-formula-scalar-transpose]. No rationalization or coefficient-system adjunction is assumed or constructed here.

source.place: Displayed natural Hom bijections and final paragraph identifying evaluation transposes with the compact-support counit; integral realization as in thm-coef-integral-verdier.proof.md; original item proof step 2.

proof.text: For every M, formula_existsUnique supplies an isomorphism from the given G(M) to the actual integral dual-formula object with the specified projection, completion, evaluation and trace equation. Use these components and their inverses.

For an arrow M to N, transpose the two candidate composites under tensor-Hom and the integral exceptional adjunction. Evaluation naturality, naturality of ordinary projection and completion, and the fixed trace identify both transposes. Currying and inverse evaluation-defined biduality give the inverse transpose. Carry out this natural Hom calculation in the coherent integral mapping system, not by treating equality at individual finite reductions as faithful. Thus G.map followed by the component equals the component followed by the double-contravariant dual-pullback-dual map, and the components assemble into e.

The counit of adj.ofNatIsoRight e at M is Rf_! of e.inv.app M followed by the original counit. Substitute this formula into FormulaNormalized for the identity of the formula object. Naturality of projection and the compact-support realization moves e.inv through the first tensor argument. The representative-normalized signed symmetry moves it through the evaluation factor; e.inv and e.hom cancel. The remaining equation is exactly the original component normalization from step 1. All calculations use the same aX,aZ,aY and actual completion augmentation.

theorem integralDualFormulaComparison
    (aX : IntegralHom.TensorPresentation.{u, u} X
      (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E X))
    (aZ : IntegralHom.TensorPresentation.{u, u} c.Z
      (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E c.Z))
    (aY : IntegralHom.TensorPresentation.{u, u} Y
      (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E Y))
    (sX : IntegralVerdier.SignedSymmetry X _ aX)
    (G : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E Y ⥤ sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E X)
    (adj : sfCompactSupportFiniteIntegralFunctor l D.k
      (PurCompactSupport.coefficientPrimeUnit l D hl) c E ⊣ G) :
    ∃ e : G ≅
        (IntegralVerdier.restrictedDual l E Y wY.omega.obj pY).rightOp ⋙
          (@constructibleIntegralPullback l _ E _ _ _ X Y f
            (RationalVerdier.units D l hl X) (RationalVerdier.units D l hl Y)).op ⋙
          IntegralVerdier.restrictedDual l E X wX.omega.obj pX,
      ∀ M : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E Y,
        CoefDualFormulaScalarTranspose.FormulaNormalized D l hl E f c wX wY aX aZ aY sX
          _ (adj.ofNatIsoRight e) M (Iso.refl _)
